releaseNotes: Prayer alarm simplifications plus a new one-off Reminders feature. The Prayer screen no longer shows the test button or the mechanical 'verified in system' status line — the alarm just works. The Daily reading reminder tile is now a proper Reminders screen: set one-off alarms at any date and time with your own note, get a gentle chime + the note on screen, snooze 9 minutes, or delete. Reminders ring reliably with the same dual-trigger engine as the prayer alarm and survive reboots.
